prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” roofing company for every Dallas homeowner — the right choice depends on your location, roof type, budget, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and how important things like long warranties or high-end materials are. I can help pick a great contractor for you if you tell me your ZIP code and a few details. Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to find and vet the best roof replacement contractor in Dallas.

What I need from you to make specific recommendations
- ZIP code or neighborhood (Dallas is big).  
- Roof type (asphalt shingles, metal, tile, flat/modified bitumen).  
- Are you filing an insurance claim?  
- Desired timeline and rough budget (low, mid, premium).  

How to choose the best company (quick checklist)
1. Local experience: Has the contractor done many jobs in Dallas neighborhoods and pulled permits with the City of Dallas?  
2. Licensing & insurance: Ask for current general liability and workers’ comp certificates. Get their TX registration/contractor info (even if Texas doesn’t have a single statewide roofing license, reputable companies will provide documentation).  
3. Manufacturer certifications: Look for GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Platinum, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, etc. Those mean access to better warranties.  
4. Written estimate & contract: Detailed line items for materials, labor, tear-off vs overlay, disposal. Clear start/end dates and payment schedule.  
5. Warranties: Manufacturer warranty and a workmanship warranty from the contractor (length and whether it’s transferable).  
6. References & reviews: Request recent local references and check Google, BBB, Yelp, Angi. Look for how the company handled problems.  
7. Permits and cleanup: Contractor should pull permits and provide a final inspection report. They should remove nails/debris and offer magnet sweep.  
8. Lien releases: Ask for lien releases and final invoices once work is paid.

Questions to ask every roofer
- How many roof replacements have you done in the last 12 months in Dallas?  
- Do you pull the building permits and handle inspections? (Yes = good.)  
- Can you provide proof of insurance and three local references?  
- What manufacturer and workmanship warranties come with this job?  
- Who will be my project manager and how do I contact them?  
- How do you handle storm/insurance claims (if applicable)?

Red flags
- Only uses verbal estimates or demands large upfront cash.  
- No local references, poor or no online presence, or lots of unresolved BBB complaints.  
- Pushy sales tactics (“only today” discounts) or asks you to sign an insurance assignment without explanation.  
- No permit pulling or “we’ll do it without permits” approach.

If you want, I can
- Provide a short vetted list (3–5) of well-reviewed Dallas roofers near you (tell me ZIP).  
- Draft an email template or checklist to send contractors for bids.  
- Help compare written estimates you already have.

Tell me your ZIP and a couple of details (roof type / insurance / budget) and I’ll find top local options and a next-step plan.
